narrative_shape: Long, near-silent Bash/Read grind on the same seven files. Context is pinned near 130k and 12 compactions have already fired by T75 (14 by T90, 20 by T120, 36 by T210). Re-read counts on _cenc.c, divide.py and _e2.c climb steadily with zero new read paths from T75 through T210, and the whole prefix carries about 36 characters of assistant text until ~T225. The character changes around T225-240: a new scratch path appears, narration starts, and the tail becomes a closeout (tidy comments and delete files T236, ctest cases T266, brief amendment while gates run T284, Monitor wait T279). The pack cannot show whether the 150-turn middle was converging debugging or thrash; the churn signature is present from the first checkpoint and persists.

rationale: Churn signature is visible from T75: heavy compaction, rising re-reads on a fixed set of files, no new inputs, and almost no narration. Late closeout after T225 shows the run did recover, but nothing at or before T120 distinguishes productive debugging from a loop. Labelled early_thrash on the early signature; confidence moderate.
